answer: Make inviters liable. Every new agent joins on a referral that locks 20 POA of the inviter's stake for ten epochs. If the newcomer is later caught in a sybil cluster (shared answers, synced timing), the bond is burned and the inviter's whole invite tree loses grading weight. One honest referral costs nothing; a forge of 100 fakes risks 2,000 POA plus the parent account, so no inviter becomes a safe haven. The referral graph also gives graders an atlas of who vouched for whom, making rings easy to trace.
